adapter.rationale: PiAiAdapter.imageRequestTarget needs the settings/credentials-backed profile snapshot; the replay mounts the real LlmRuntime dispatch path and an adapter whose target expression is pi-ai's own requestImageDimensions(w,h,pixelBudget) + maxBytes (dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:1379-1384, :1837-1845).

isolation.mode: temporary harness home; attachments/v1 symlinked to the real store; empty cache/

mitigated.label: A · mitigated
mitigated.title: live commandcode profile today
mitigated.notes: Live profile policy. The unguarded peak is 5.98 MiB, 0.33% below the 6 MiB plugin budget, so the guard stayed a no-op (0 events, 0 unsatisfiable). Acceptance is met by the route policy, not by any omission.

unmitigated.label: B · unmitigated
unmitigated.title: pi-ai defaults, no config-layer mitigation
unmitigated.notes: pi-ai defaults with the default floor (6/12). The guard emitted 8 events and cut the peak from 17.06 to 11.49 MiB, but 11 steps remain above 6 MiB because the protected suffix alone is 11.49 MiB; the 20 MiB adapter ceiling is never reached. Acceptance on the plugin budget fails.

tuned-floor.label: C · unmitigated, tuned floor (retainSteps 0 / minRetainImages 6)
tuned-floor.title: pi-ai defaults with a zero-step retention window
tuned-floor.provenance: same route policy as B; guard config overrides minRetainImages=6, retainSteps=0 (integration-test floor)
tuned-floor.notes: pi-ai defaults with retainSteps 0 / minRetainImages 6. The guard emitted 8 events; peak after 5.96 MiB; 0 unsatisfiable steps. Acceptance met: with a zero-step window every occurrence older than the newest 6 is eligible, so the batched paste stops being protected as a block.

adapter.targetPolicySource: same route policy as B; guard config overrides minRetainImages=6, retainSteps=0 (integration-test floor)

floor-sweep-demo.label: C2 · floor sweep (retainSteps 4 / minRetainImages 4)
floor-sweep-demo.title: why lowering minRetainImages alone cannot reach the budget
floor-sweep-demo.provenance: same route policy as B; the 4/4 floor is the evidence pass showing per-message recent protection dominates
floor-sweep-demo.notes: pi-ai defaults with minRetainImages 4 / retainSteps 4 — the evidence pass, not the fix. Peak after 10.29 MiB with 3 unsatisfiable step(s): `retainSteps` protects every image admitted in a recent step, so a batched paste is protected as a whole and lowering `minRetainImages` alone cannot get below that batch's size. Lower the step window first when the budget still cannot be met.

adapter.targetPolicySource: same route policy as B; the 4/4 floor is the evidence pass showing per-message recent protection dominates

floorSweep.note: Lowering the floor keeps fewer images verbatim; the sweep reports the mildest setting that still reaches 6 MiB.
